sitemapUrlAudit.homepageCtaInteractiveNesting: fixed; RFQ and destination links are separate interactive elements

productionProbe.uaProbe: Normal, mobile, Googlebot and Google-InspectionTool UA simulations returned matching key-route HTML hashes; this is not proof of Google's actual fetch.
productionProbe.latencyNote: Network-inclusive 28-URL probe p50 approximately 1.47s and maximum approximately 3.43s; dynamic TTFB samples approximately 0.4-1.2s.

crawlGuard.linkCheckScope: Up to the first 20 unique non-API internal links per sitemap page

crawlerEvidence.releaseRelation: Historical 2.3 deployment-window request; before the b43ce31 final production code sequence.
crawlerEvidence.qualification: Observed request presented a Googlebot UA; UA is spoofable and no reverse-DNS verification is claimed.

gsc.interpretation: Live-test eligibility and queue acceptance do not mean indexed; Google-selected canonical and new crawl date remain unverified.

indexNow.meaning: Accepted by IndexNow endpoint; not an indexing guarantee and not Google's Indexing API.

contentAndTrust.unconfirmedMeasurementNameHandling: When runtime length_cm is null, cm tokens are removed from the public product name, title and image alt; confirmed lengths are preserved.
contentAndTrust.seoLanguage: English URLs only; client locale UI exists but no hreflang/locale sitemap.
contentAndTrust.analytics: Privacy-gated event scaffold only; no GA4 measurement ID, consent UI, GTM, Vercel Analytics or Speed Insights data.
